description: This file is a shell library that provides functions for starting, stopping, and managing a git daemon for testing purposes. It includes setup for daemon process, network communication, and environment checks relevant to testing the git daemon functionality.

methods.name: start_git_daemon
methods.description: Starts the git daemon with specified configurations, ensuring only one instance runs at a time, setting up necessary paths, and verifying startup success.

methods.name: stop_git_daemon
methods.description: Stops the running git daemon, terminates processes, and cleans up temporary files.

methods.name: fake_nc
methods.description: A simplified netcat-like function that connects to a specified host:port, sends data, and outputs the response.
